results.description:
She doesn't yield.
He doesn't quit.
And chemistry was never supposed to be part of the deal.

Harper Merrick has spent her life fighting for respect in the boys' club of stock car racing. Now she's risking everything to launch the sport's first all-female team with her aunt and her fearless driver best friend. It's bold. It's groundbreaking. And it's about to fall apart thanks to a brutal funding crisis.

Enter Cal McBane—billionaire investor, silver-tongued charmer, and the last man Harper wants anywhere near her dream.

Cal is bored with his predictable life, and Harper's fire is impossible to resist. Investing in her team is thrilling. Falling for her? Dangerous. But when he starts offering ideas, making connections, and getting hands-on, Harper sees only one thing: a man trying to take control.

Their attraction is instant.
Their clashes are explosive.
Their timing couldn't be worse.

With the media circling, her ex stirring trouble, and misunderstandings piling up, Harper and Cal must decide if falling for each other is worth risking everything they've built.

Boss Lady is a slow-burn, high-heat contemporary sports romance filled with banter, ambition, found family, and irresistible workplace tension.
